paragraphs.text: That is, has freely loved the posterity of Abraham.

paragraphs.text: He joined God's power with his will, to the intent that we should not separate them and by this he wills God's people to depend on his power which he confirms by examples.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: He shows what fruit the godly conceive of God's power, by which they see how he destroys his enemies, and delivers his people.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: That is, govern and defend his people.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: By showing the punishment God appoints for the heathen idolaters, he warns his people to beware of the same offences, seeing that idols have neither power nor life, and that their deliverance came not by idols, but by the mighty power of God, see Ps 115:4-14.
